answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like a falcon monitoring a gale, nodes must lock collateral to participate, ensuring every echo of consensus is backed by skin in the game. An attacker seeking to create multiple identities faces prohibitive costs, as they must acquire a majority of the network value to subvert finality, effectively rendering the execution of a Sybil attack economically irrational.
